purpose: Step 3: dynamic training against standard ParT training on the 8M training set (train8m_head: train8m without the sel1m_tail rows), both selected on sel1m_tail, seed 12345. Standard ParT is Weaver flat+decay restarted from the epoch-17 checkpoint (start LRs 1e-5 to 1e-3); dynamic training is the fast windowed PBT with fallback copies. Primary comparison: fast PBT against standard ParT.
